recognition_hooks.hook_text: Eye of Reckoning Warlord: whirlwind motion identity

spine.mech_note: Eye of Reckoning: channel while moving, spinning blades of fire and physical damage in a cyclone around the body, hitting everything in a radius continuously. Warlord (Soldier + Oathkeeper) uses Stoneguard or Octavius sets to amplify EoR damage and Shield Throw interactions. Unlike WW Barbarian (melee contact), EoR's radius hits at arm's length — the cyclone precedes the body, hitting enemies before they reach the caster. Resource: Soldier's Menhir's Bulwark + shield stats allow facetanking while channeling, making this the tankiest channel-move identity in GD. The Forgotten Gods-era addition (2019) gave the game its spin-to-win; Guardians of Cairn set further cemented the identity with EoR-specific bonuses. High-end viable on Celestial bosses with good itemization.
